summary: OCHA reports more than 220 olive trees vandalized in six incidents and additional settler property/livestock damage in twelve incidents.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA 17 Mar 2023 Husan tree destruction; PLO NAD Monthly Report March 2023; canonical Google Sheet dedup check
resolution_notes: Unresolved-first decomposition materially narrowed the aggregate. The Husan component is already canonical as ILPV-2023-0322: WAFA reports nearly 50 olive trees cut in Husan on Mar.17, NAD records 50 trees on Mar.17, and OCHA includes Husan in its Mar.14-27 aggregate. The Yasuf/As-Sawiya Mar.14/15 cutting is already canonical as ILPV-2023-0324 and likely accounts for OCHA's As Sawiya lane; do not double-count or allocate OCHA's aggregate total. OCHA says six incidents but names seven localities (Sinjil, As Sawiya, Burin, Al Ganoub, Halhul, Husan, Deir Istiya), so the remaining locality components cannot be mapped one-for-one by inference. MAR23-016 stays Unresolved while Sinjil/Burin/Al Ganoub/Halhul/Deir Istiya components are decomposed or explicitly blocked.
media_status: No exact new incident media recovered for the remaining aggregate components; no generic or merely related imagery used.
